'''Official Tournament Sealed Deck''' is the 13th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in May 1998. It is a sealed-play box with 18 exclusive black-border premium cards (9 Light Side and 9 Dark Side). CardGuide numbering: 13th product. MSRP $19.95.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref><ref name="wook">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Official_Tournament_Sealed_Deck Official Tournament Sealed Deck] at Wookieepedia</ref>

Each box also contained four [[Premiere Unlimited]] booster packs, one [[A New Hope Limited]] booster pack, a rule book, and a 300-card storage box. The storage-box cover was one of six, concealed at purchase: Boba Fett, C-3PO, Darth Vader, Jabba the Hutt, Leia, or Luke Skywalker.<ref name="encyc" />

== Packaging ==
The product is the sealed box, not a booster expansion. Randomized Premiere and A New Hope packs inside are reprints of those sets and are not listed here.
